behavior_constraints: audit <environment> generates a read-only audit report with header, seven sections, and footer in exact order
deployment summary lists deployed services alphabetically with full version and deployment ISO timestamp, or (no services deployed)
replica summary lists deployed services alphabetically with explicit replica count or default 1, or (no services deployed)
health summary lists deployed services alphabetically with explicit state or default healthy, or (no services deployed)
quota status lists quotas alphabetically with limit, current usage, and OK or EXCEEDED, or (no quotas set)
config variables list only key names alphabetically, or (no config variables)
lock status prints Locked: <reason> or Unlocked
recent activity shows last 10 events newest first in history display format, or (no events)
audit works on locked environments and generates no events
unknown environment errors with ERROR: unknown environment '<environment>'
entities.summary: This round adds a read-only audit command that aggregates deployment, replicas, health, quotas, config, lock, and recent activity into a human-readable or JSON report for an environment.

instruction_head:
Add an audit report command to the pipeline orchestrator. The audit command generates a comprehensive compliance report for an environment, aggregating deployment state, replicas, health, quotas, config, lock status, and recent activity into a single read-only view.
